correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the support-function identity: only the southwest normal quadrant contributes to the deficit; the triangular-cap probability is (1-t^2/(ab))^n on its exact support; Tonelli and a beta integral reduce the expectation to the stated one-variable kernel. Taylor’s signed remainder for (1+x)^(-3/2) gives strict alternating truncation inequalities and a summable coefficient tail, including n=0. The gamma-ratio expansion yields the stated n^-1/2, n^-3/2 and separate n^-2 terms. The numerical checker is corroborative, not the infinite proof.
residual_risks: Only Euclidean mean length in the specified right-triangle model is proved.
No variance, distributional law, or affine transfer to arbitrary triangles is asserted.
Full text of Efron 1965 remains an access/priority risk.

evidence: Buchta’s exact primary result is the distribution of the number of chain vertices, not edge lengths (Mathematika 53 (2006), DOI 10.1112/S0025579300000127).
